**Finding submitted: deviation (Section 3.4(b), ¶p0046).**

- **Issue:** Termination for convenience is conditioned on our paying "early termination charges... specified in Attachment A and applicable Service Option Attachments." No amount is fixed in the Agreement, and IBM may unilaterally change Attachment A on 90 days' notice (§13.1), so the charge is effectively open-ended — short of the fallback (early-termination fee capped at 3 months' fees).
- **Redline (validated, fallback level):** cap the charge at three (3) months' recurring charges for the terminated Services, make it the sole amount payable on termination, and confirm no other liquidated damages or penalties are payable by us.
- **Not flagged:** §3.3 (IBM forfeits early termination charges when in breach) and §9.2's cap on Customer damages both run in our favour; IBM-side credits/LDs are compliant by definition under this rule.
